title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten documented John Carroll rituals, campus landmarks, and gatherings that connect Blue Streaks across the academic year.

cards.title: Meet Lobo at the Quad
cards.subtitle: Blue & Gold tradition • John Carroll University
cards.notes: Look for Lobo at games, move-in, and major campus moments; the university identifies the wolf as a familiar part of Blue Streak gatherings.
cards.short_summary: JCU’s wolf mascot anchors photos, welcomes, and game-day spirit.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll says Lobo appears at games, welcomes, move-in, and big campus moments, including photos on the Quad.
cards.access_notes: Check the university events calendar or athletics schedule for appearances.

cards.title: Pause for Tower Time
cards.subtitle: Saint Ignatius Plaza • John Carroll University
cards.notes: Stop by the clock tower on a Wednesday for the campus’s short coffee-and-conversation reset, held on Saint Ignatius Plaza.
cards.short_summary: A midweek gathering by the clock tower built around conversation and coffee.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll describes Tower Time as a Wednesday, campus-wide 30-minute pause by the clock tower on Saint Ignatius Plaza.
cards.access_notes: The tradition is described as occurring on Wednesdays; confirm a specific week’s event details before going.

cards.title: Take the Long Way Around the Quad
cards.subtitle: Hamlin Quad • John Carroll University
cards.notes: Follow the community custom of using the paths around the Quad instead of cutting directly across the grass, leaving room for chance conversations.
cards.short_summary: A student-described Quad custom that favors paths and community encounters.
cards.evidence_claim: On its traditions page, John Carroll features a student describing the custom that no one walks directly across the Quad.
cards.access_notes: Use established walkways and follow any posted grounds guidance.

cards.title: Open the Year at Convocation
cards.subtitle: Incoming-class welcome • John Carroll University
cards.notes: Join the formal welcome that gathers faculty and student leaders to begin the academic year with reflection and a shared call to learn and serve.
cards.short_summary: The formal opening moment for a new incoming class.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll identifies Convocation as its formal welcome to the incoming class, with faculty and student leaders marking the start of the year.
cards.access_notes: Primarily associated with the start of the academic year; follow new-student communications for attendance details.

cards.title: Begin with the Mass of the Holy Spirit
cards.subtitle: Church of the Gesu • John Carroll University
cards.notes: Attend or observe the early-year Jesuit gathering at the Church of the Gesu, where the Carroll community asks for wisdom, renewal, and connection.
cards.short_summary: JCU’s academic-year opening liturgy brings the community together at Gesu.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll says it gathers at the Church of the Gesu for the Mass of the Holy Spirit at the beginning of the academic year.
cards.access_notes: A religious service; participation should follow current university and church event guidance.

cards.title: Gather for the Welcome Back Concert
cards.subtitle: Early-semester campus concert • John Carroll University
cards.notes: Watch for the student-led early-semester concert that turns the Quad into a stage for familiar covers, new favorites, and a shared kickoff.
cards.short_summary: A student-led outdoor concert that launches the semester’s social calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll describes the Welcome Back Concert as an early-semester, student-led show that turns the Quad into a stage.
cards.access_notes: Confirm date, performer, weather plan, and any entry requirements through current campus event notices.

cards.title: Bring Family Back to the Heights
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide weekend • John Carroll University
cards.notes: Plan a family visit around campus tours, arts and athletics events, alumni awards, and Cleveland outings presented during the university’s family weekend.
cards.short_summary: A campus-wide weekend designed for students, families, and alumni.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll describes Parent & Family Weekend as a full-campus return featuring tours, arts and athletics events, alumni awards, and Cleveland outings.
cards.access_notes: Event components may require registration or tickets; check the current program before making plans.

cards.title: Return for Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide gathering • John Carroll University
cards.notes: Use the annual return to reconnect through campus tours, arts and athletics, alumni recognition, tailgating by the Quad, and Cleveland-area activities.
cards.short_summary: A broad Blue Streak reunion weekend spanning campus and Cleveland activities.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll lists Homecoming as a full-campus return with tailgating by the Quad, alumni awards, arts and athletics events, tours, and Cleveland outings.
cards.access_notes: Choose current all-ages events and verify any registration, ticketing, or venue rules in the official schedule.

cards.title: See What’s New on the Pacelli Lion
cards.subtitle: Near Pacelli Hall • John Carroll University
cards.notes: Visit the stone lion near Pacelli Hall and look for its latest paint layers, added by student groups to mark events, causes, and campus creativity.
cards.short_summary: A painted stone lion that records student-group moments in changing layers.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll calls the Pacelli Lion a stone landmark near Pacelli Hall that student groups repaint to celebrate events, causes, and campus creativity.
cards.access_notes: View the landmark respectfully; painting activity should occur only through authorized student-group participation.

cards.title: Reconnect at Reunion
cards.subtitle: Summer alumni weekend • John Carroll University
cards.notes: Follow reunion programming for a summer gathering that brings alumni from around the world back into mentoring, service, and Blue Streak community connections.
cards.short_summary: A summer tradition linking current JCU life with its worldwide alumni community.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll says its summer reunion weekend brings together alumni from around the world who remain engaged through mentoring, giving back, and connection.
cards.access_notes: Programming is geared to alumni and may include registration-dependent events; consult the official reunion information.
